en: A vintage winter street scene showing a broad snow-covered avenue lined with multi‑story stone and brick buildings on the left and right. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street and sidewalks. In the distance a church spire rises over the rooftops. The card has a muted, monochrome print with light blue tones and red captions identifying the location.
